# @ndigo/dispatcher

Request dispatch, parameter binding, and radix handler mappings for Ndigo

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `likeArgumentResolver` — Type guard for HandlerMethodArgumentResolver.

- `RouteDispatcher` *(type)* — Interface for dispatching routes.
- `RouteRenderer` *(type)* — Interface for rendering a ModelAndView.
- `DISPATCH_ERROR_ATTRIBUTE` — Route attribute key under which the dispatcher records a dispatch/render failure that it swallowed (DSV-B1).
- `setDispatchError` — Records a swallowed dispatch failure on the route (DSV-B1).
- `getDispatchError` — Reads the swallowed dispatch failure recorded on the route, if any.
- `AbstractDispatcher` — An abstract, platform-independent application dispatcher.
- `NoHandlerFoundError` — Error thrown when no suitable handler is found for a given route. This typically indicates a misconfiguration or an unhandled route.
- `NoViewFoundError` — Error thrown when a view cannot be resolved for a given view name and route. This indicates that the specified view template or component could not be located.
- `RouteBindingError` — An error that represents a failure to retrieve a required Route property.
- `ParameterBindingError` — Base error for method parameter binding issues. Analogous to the request-binding error model.
- `InvalidParameterMappingError` — Thrown when parameter mapping configuration is invalid. This is a CONFIGURATION error (application startup time).
- `MissingParameterError` — Thrown when a required parameter is missing from the request. This is a RUNTIME error (request processing time). Analogous to the missing-parameter binding err…
- `ParameterConversionError` — Thrown when a parameter converter fails at runtime. This is a RUNTIME error (request processing time).
